visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens on a woman with long dark hair, wearing a white winter jacket and a black Chanel-branded beanie, kneeling in a snowy landscape. She holds a black bowl and addresses the camera with high energy. Beside her is a massive, textured bank of white snow. She scoops a large amount of snow into the bowl, pressing it down with her gloved hands. (2) She turns the bowl over onto her hand, revealing a dome-shaped block of snow. She looks at it with a mix of pride and humor. The background shows distant snow-covered trees and a grey, overcast sky. (3) A young boy in a black hooded puffer jacket enters the frame. He holds a yellow plastic snowball-making tool that resembles large tongs with spherical ends. He demonstrates how to scoop snow and snap the tool shut, creating a perfectly round, smooth snowball. He maintains a serious, almost mocking facial expression towards the camera. (4) A fast-paced montage shows the boy repeatedly using the tool to line up a row of identical snowballs on a ledge. The background reveals a large, multi-story resort building with gabled roofs, surrounded by a heavy winter environment. He picks up a snowball, displays it to the lens, and waves goodbye.
